title: Autumn Yoga Retreat
short_description: This is an invitation to immerse yourself in a peaceful setting and enriching functional yoga practice, connecting with your inner experience and unique anatomy. Guided by Ehud Neuhaus, it’s a chance to slow down and explore your practice in a playful, introspective way.
description:
This is an invitation to immerse yourself in a peaceful environment and a deeply enriching functional yoga practice, connecting to your inner experience and deepening your understanding of your unique anatomy. Guided by Ehud Neuhaus, it’s an opportunity to slow down and explore the subtleties of your practice in a playful and introspective way.

[More information](https://yoga.ehudneuhaus.com/)
